findings.title: Webcam and AX tracking reactivate while locked on screen-wake or spoofed DistributedNotification
findings.rationale: Closed in Round 2 (TRG-04): `SystemSessionStateProvider` queries `CGSessionCopyCurrentDictionary()` on init, on workspace/distributed notifications (treating `DistributedNotificationCenter` events solely as re-poll hints), and on `0.25s`-TTL `isSessionActive()` checks, failing closed when the dictionary is unavailable or `CGSSessionScreenIsLocked == true`, while `AppController.runCalibrateCommand()` (`AppController.swift:42-63`) and `FocusCoordinator.supervise` (`FocusCoordinator.swift:289-298`) gate and abort camera capture on inactive sessions (proven by T59 and T78).

references.title: CWE-807: Reliance on Untrusted Inputs in a Security Decision

findings.title: CGWindowCatalogService drops layer != 0 windows, blinding hit-testing to modal and auth dialogs
findings.rationale: Closed in Round 2 (TRG-05): `CGWindowCatalogService` classifies all on-screen windows via `WindowClassifier` (with `kCGWindowOwnerName` fallback for unbundled security agents like `coreautha`), retaining `layer > 0` dialogs/panels as `.occluder` windows (`WindowHitTester.isEligible` requires `window.layer == 0`) and elevating `SecurityAgent`, `CoreAuthUI`, `UserNotificationCenter`, `CoreServicesUIAgent`, and `loginwindow` (`layer >= 1000`) to global `.securityPrompt` vetoes in both `step()` and `confirm()` (proven by T60, T61, T62, T77, and live G7 `--doctor`).

references.title: CWE-1021: Improper Restriction of Rendered UI Layers or Frames

findings.title: SafetyPolicy skips Config.hardBlocklist when requireAllowedSource is false and omits CoreAuthUI
findings.rationale: Closed in Round 2 (TRG-06): `DefaultSafetyGuardPolicy.evaluate(_:)` unconditionally denies switching when `frontmostBundleID` belongs to `Config.hardBlocklist` regardless of `requireAllowedSource`, and `Config.hardBlocklist` (`Config.swift:16-31`) now includes `com.apple.LocalAuthentication.UIAgent`, `com.apple.UserNotificationCenter`, `com.apple.ScreenSharing`, and `com.apple.Settings` (proven by T63).

findings.title: Build and app-signing scripts execute and sign binaries from predictable shared /tmp directories
findings.rationale: Closed in Round 2 (TRG-17): `scripts/sbx.sh` and `scripts/bundle-app.sh` default all scratch and module-cache paths to UID-scoped directories (`-$(id -u)`) and enforce `prepare_secure_dir()` (trailing-slash normalisation, symlink refusal `-L`, regular-file refusal, `mkdir -p -m 0700`, UID ownership check `-O`, and `chmod 0700`), verified automatically by `scripts/check-scripts.sh` (Gate G6).
findings.evidence:
if [ -L "$d" ]; then echo "refusing symlink: $d" >&2; exit 1; fi
mkdir -p -m 0700 "$d"
if [ -L "$d" ] || [ ! -d "$d" ] || [ ! -O "$d" ]; then echo "refusing unowned or replaced directory: $d" >&2; exit 1; fi
chmod 0700 "$d"

findings.title: Uninvalidated PID-keyed bundleIDCache misclassifies windows after macOS PID wraparound
findings.rationale: Closed in Round 2 (TRG-12): Persistent actor-level `bundleIDCache` has been removed and replaced with a per-`detailedSnapshot()` local `var pidBundleCache: [Int32: String?] = [:]`, eliminating stale PID-wraparound inheritance and unbounded cache growth.
findings.evidence:
// TRG-12: local per-snapshot PID cache avoids PID-wraparound stale bundle IDs.
var pidBundleCache: [Int32: String?] = [:]

references.title: CWE-672: Operation on a Resource after Expiration or Release

findings.title: SecureFileStore.read accepts group/world-writable config directories and uses path-based TOCTOU
findings.rationale: Closed in Round 2 (TRG-18): `SecureFileStore.read` and `write` pin a directory descriptor with `open(path, O_RDONLY | O_DIRECTORY | O_NOFOLLOW | O_CLOEXEC)` (catching Darwin's `ENOTDIR` symlink return), reject `(dirStat.st_mode & 0o077) != 0` on `read`, repair permissions via `fchmod(dirFD, ...)` on `write`, and execute `openat`, `renameat`, and `unlinkat` relative to `dirFD` (proven by T34 and T71).

references.title: CWE-732: Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource

findings.title: FocusCoordinator appends unbounded DecisionLogEntry records at 20-30 Hz, leaking heap memory
findings.rationale: Closed in Round 2 (TRG-07): `FocusCoordinator.decisionLog` is now a pre-allocated O(1) `RingBuffer` bounded at `maxDecisionLogEntries = 4096` (proven by T64 while preserving T38).

findings.title: Cancelling or failing interactive calibration silently clears user pause state and starts camera
findings.rationale: Closed in Round 2 (TRG-26): `AppController.runInteractiveCalibration()` captures `let wasPaused = await coordinator.paused()` prior to pausing/stopping the coordinator and restores `await coordinator.setPaused(wasPaused)` on every exit path (permission denial, locked session, cancellation, error, and completion).
